restoration_note: Teaching 29 maps the throne-structure of divine dominion in two parallel registers — nine outer thrones in the aeons of Greatness, then nine corresponding thrones inside the cosmos (three in each ship, plus seventh firmament, eighth in air, ninth lowest). Restorations are tightly constrained where (a) editor traces fix single letters in well-known formulas, (b) the parallel ordinal structure ⲧⲧⲙⲁϩ-X ⲛ̄ⲑⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ forces predictable bridges, and (c) the spiritual reading specifies the divine person at each station. I confirmed editor proposals for the chapter heading, ordinal series, ⲉⲧⲥⲙⲁⲁⲛⲧ formula, and standard divine epithets. The Living Spirit's act of raising the First Man "out of darkness" allowed restoration of {18} as ⲕⲉⲕⲉ. Gap {35} as ⲡⲙⲁϩⲥⲟⲟⲩ ('sixth') is forced by counting (3+3=6) the ship-thrones. Gaps {12-14} (Builder's secondary act) and {17}, {32}, {41}, {43}-{47} were left unrestorable: damage too extensive and no parallel formula constrains them. {26} ('thrones of the [Pleroma/Life/Greatness]?') was conservatively unrestored despite visible ⲡⲡ, since multiple equally good readings exist.
